info.title: PLMS ARE Mobile API
info.description: JSON API for the ARE mobile app (complaints, handover inspections, tenant onboarding). Every authenticated call needs a Bearer token and the X-Device-Id header of the phone bound at first login. Error body: {message, code, errors?}.

value.message: This device is not registered. Please contact the administrator.

post.description: First login binds `device_uid` to the user. A different device is refused with 403 `device_not_registered` until an admin clears it on **Masters → Mobile Devices**. Store `token` and `device_uid` in secure storage; the token never expires.
Deletes the token used for this request. The device stays registered; the next login on it succeeds.

put.description: Whole checklist every time. From stage 502 the ARE is assigned first (502 → 503). The **first** save creates the 503 inspection row — its id comes back as `data.draft.id`; use that id for photos and submit. Later saves update it and replace the lines. Totals are computed server-side: `net = Σ lines + electricity + water − maintenance_due`.
